sasha: Rolling kestrel-int4 into canary with streaming + prefix-compression. Noticed sporadic funcall/tool JSON parse errors on clients (~0.62% of canary calls).

omar: Can you paste a raw stream capture (showing chunk boundaries)? Clients say they get a parse error mid-object.

sasha: Here are two consecutive chunks from the capture (raw):
Chunk 1:
{"action":"search","args":[{"q":"redwood"}],"result":[{"id":1,"title":"Redwood Inference"},{"id":2,"title":"Redwood Models"},{"id":3,"title":"Redwood Tooling"},
Chunk 2:
"more":true}],"meta":{"cursor":"abcd"}}
The closing of the array/object lands in the next chunk; some clients call JSON.parse() on each chunk and throw. Non-streaming responses parse fine.

jen: Do failures correlate with long arrays, unicode, or specific punctuation? Any difference vs int8 canary runs?

sasha: ci-bot snapshot: json_parse_failures=0.62% baseline=0.01 failing_requests=312 total_requests=50400 (24h). Failures skew to longer result arrays and titles with curly quotes / em-dashes. Int8 canary doesn't show the spike.

matt: Two possible root causes: 1) tokenizer split inside multibyte UTF-8 sequence (quantized tokenizers sometimes slice bytes across chunks), 2) runtime prefix compaction/trimming removing sentinel bytes for tool output. If bytes are corrupted/shifted, client parsers will error.

omar: Proposed mitigations: a) sentinel-wrap tool output (e.g., `<json>...</json>`) so clients can buffer until sentinel, b) add client-side soft-buffer fallback (on parse error, wait up to 200ms and append next chunk then retry), c) runtime guard: disable prefix compaction for messages tagged as tool-output.

sasha: Filed ML-8533: /internal/issue/ML-8533. Plan: A/B 48h: 10% sentinel-wrap, 10% runtime-opt-out, 10% streaming-off, rest baseline. Collect token id traces, tokenizer raw bytes, kvprefix snapshot, and client UA for failures.

jen: I'll add a tiny replay harness to /infra/replay that can reassemble token streams and feed our parser to reproduce mid-chunk failures locally. Also will log token ids +/- 8 tokens around failure.

matt: I'll open a small PR to streamer to add an opt-out flag for prefix compaction when `message.type == "tool-output"`. PR behind a rollout guard. Also adding unit tests verifying joined-chunk UTF-8 validity so we don't emit invalid sequences.

ci-bot: experiment metrics (prelim): json_parse_failures=0.62% baseline=0.01, failing=312, total=50400.

sasha: Thanks all. Keeping canary at 10% and starting the A/B today. Sync tomorrow after 24h of signals. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
